correctness.evidence: Independent recursive maximum-insertion generation of 123/132 avoiders to n10; every 123 trivariate cell and all 572 divergence rows match, 16796 n10 objects and 39 cells.

originality.evidence: Elizalde handles partial fp/exc for single 123 and Barnabei–Bonetti–Silimbani already derive des marginal; finite three-way cross-tab and 132 divergence not found in checked works. Eulerian extensions derivative of prior GF.

scientific_value.evidence: Exact finite joint tables and earliest divergence benchmark refined bijections/GFs; no general trivariate formula.

limitations: Dyck correspondence and Eulerian generating function are prior
